patch_description: This redesign separates the planner into explicit stages: topology validation, group-to-node placement, replica budgeting, GPU packing, optional local packing refinement, and inverse-map construction. The implementation keeps the original inputs and outputs while improving placement quality through a cardinality-preserving refinement pass that exchanges heavy and light physical experts between the most imbalanced GPU packs. The data flow avoids repeated permutation construction where possible, uses vectorized layer-parallel operations, and centralizes permutation/inverse-map handling for maintainability.
